title: observability: token-level KV cache cost & latency dashboards + alert tuning
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Added token-level KV cache metrics and dashboards; updated alert thresholds to reduce noisy alerts while preserving SLO coverage; included runbook sections for degraded cache hit rates and KV serialization regressions.
description: Context: This PR adds token-level observability for KV cache (hits/misses/evictions), token-level cost and latency breakdowns, and a set of Grafana dashboards + alert tuning to make regression detection actionable. Motivation: customers running low-latency chat workloads need visibility into per-token cost drivers (KV cache effectiveness, batching, and compilation overhead). Without token-level metrics it's difficult to correlate latency regressions with cache behavior or model variants. What changed: added new Prometheus metrics (redwood_kv_token_hits_total, redwood_kv_token_misses_total, redwood_kv_token_evictions_total, redwood_token_cost_per_token_usd, redwood_token_latency_p50_us, p95_us, p99_us), instrumented tracing spans for KV lookup and token emit, introduced Grafana dashboards (Token-Level Cost/Latency, KV Cache Health, Token Breakdown by Model Variant), and updated alerting rules to reduce false positives and alert on meaningful regressions (p95 latency increase >15% for 5m with low traffic guard, KV miss rate >8% sustained for 10m). Also: added lightweight aggregator on the metrics pipeline to compute per-route and per-model token cost aggregates for the dashboards; included migration guide to ensure older dashboards keep working. Rollout and safety: feature gated behind config observability.token_kv.enabled (off by default for Dedicated/Private until rollout), gradual rollout plan (10% hosts -> 50% -> 100%), and performance checks to ensure metric emission overhead <1%. Testing: unit tests for metric labels and integrations tests exercising dashboards against a local Prometheus/Grafana stack. Links: Linear ENG-4582, ENG-4620; support ticket SUP-1123. Checklist: - [x] Add metrics and tracing spans - [x] Add dashboards and panels - [x] Add alert rules and runbook - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Smoke rollout and perf verification - [x] Docs + migration guide Notes: tuned alert thresholds after two staging runs to avoid noisy alerts from startup churn; runbook includes steps to revert to fallback model variant and how to temporarily disable token-level metrics if ingestion cost spikes.
